description: The article modified a comprehensive anesthesiology resident curriculum into a skill-focused version targeting one objective: successful US-guided cannulation.
title: Skill-focused curriculum design: task-specific modifications to reduce cognitive load and target a single procedural objective

description: The article defines two skill-targeted explanation styles for LLM rewrites of Python error messages, designed for different assessed proficiency levels.
title: Skill-targeted explanation styles: pragmatic versus contingent LLM error-message rewrites

description: The article evaluates a social and emotional learning curriculum that the title describes as \"Skill-Targeted\", meaning it targets specific SEL skills rather than a general approach.
title: Skill-targeted social and emotional learning curriculum evaluated in the trial

description: The article organizes its training design and analyses around models of learning-skill development, chiefly Hattie and Donoghue's (2016) framework and Efklides' (2011) MASRL model.
title: Skill-training design model: introduce surface declarative knowledge, consolidate to conceptual understanding, then prepare transfer to applied settings

description: An educational activity integrated into two existing courses: Data Mining (5 ECTS, Fontys) and Projects in Data Science (7.5 ECTS, ITU).
title: Two-part skin lesion annotation activity (individual dataset exploration plus group annotation on a 3-point scale) implemented at Fontys and ITU Copenhagen

description: SKIT is a murder-mystery game–based, role-play scenario simulation approach in which rotating residents play patients, family members, doctors, and nurses under instructor guidance.
title: Script Killing Immersive Teaching (SKIT) model: full-process task chain, role responsibility binding, and dynamic NPC intervention

description: The authors' forward-looking rollout recommendations for adopting SKIT beyond the pilot: build a standardized scenario library, certify instructors, and integrate technology.
title: Scale SKIT through scenario standardization, instructor certification, and VR/AI integration

description: A worked example scenario in Box 1 that concretizes the SKIT method: an adult road-traffic casualty with suspected severe TBI moves from ED triage through resuscitation, head CT imaging, and handoff.
title: Example SKIT scenario: traffic accident with suspected traumatic brain injury

description: Skyline College's Education/Child Development Program is a traditional community college department preparing early educators for classroom teaching toward an associate degree or Child Development Permit.
title: Skyline College Education/Child Development Program: community college lab school with mentored clinical practice
